model.name: Room folder dual-identity resolves to BOTH faces (contents + verbs) from one selection — no split-identity broken half
model.description: DEFECT FAMILY (tester-measured root, Tron saw the prod face): a room folder has TWO identities — a real folder UUID (resolved by /api/ior) and a roomcoll LOCATION REF (resolved by /api/trace/children) — and NEITHER api resolves BOTH. So whichever ref the tree uses, one half of the detail breaks. TWO FACES of ONE root: prod 0.8.174 shows the verbs with an EMPTY BODY (children unresolved by real uuid; the face Tron has SEEN); scratch-with-fix shows the nesting with NO VERBS (unit unresolved by roomcoll ref). FIX: one selection resolves BOTH faces (unit->verbs incl add-folder AND children->contents) via ONE canonical folder-identity resolution. User terms (Tron): selecting a folder shows its contents and lets you add a folder inside it.

discoverySource.measuredRoot: tester: /api/ior resolves the folder real uuid; /api/trace/children resolves its roomcoll location ref; neither resolves both -> whichever ref the tree uses, one detail half breaks.
discoverySource.twoFaces: prod 0.8.174 = verbs + EMPTY body (children unresolved by real uuid, Tron saw this); scratch-with-fix = nesting + NO verbs (unit unresolved by roomcoll ref)
discoverySource.customerNotTester: Tron SEEING the prod empty-body face = OUR verification failure (a customer experiencing a bug), not a step; WE verify via member-session @390, he accepts.

model.buildable: basic functionality (the folder Tron sees broken on prod) — buildable-NOW, not capture-only-deferred.
model.crossRefNote: The dual-identity resolution that makes BOTH the verbs face (R40.78 add-folder) AND the children/contents face (R40.82 folder-owns-children) work from one selection. Resolution sibling of R35.2 (every item resolves to a real unit, both buttons work) — this names the SPECIFIC two-API-two-ref split. Room Files real-Folder-unit context = R37.21. Root lens: one canonical identity, the split IS the duplication defect.
model.satisfactionStatus: UNVERIFIED (root measured, two faces reproduced; unified resolution + gates unbuilt, no stub RED observed — honest third state).

acceptanceCriteria.text: ROOT FIX: selecting a room folder resolves BOTH faces from ONE selection — the real folder UUID (its unit -> verbs incl add-folder) AND its children (its contents). Neither /api/ior-by-real-uuid ALONE nor /api/trace/children-by-roomcoll-ref ALONE is sufficient. A resolution that yields only ONE face => RED.

gateRef.assertion: one selection resolves the folder unit (verbs) AND its children (contents); only-one-face => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a selection that resolves only the unit OR only the children -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The face Tron SAW on prod 0.8.174: selecting a folder shows verbs with an EMPTY body (children unresolved by real uuid). AC: a folder with children shows its CONTENTS, not an empty body. Empty-body-on-a-folder-that-has-children => RED.

gateRef.assertion: children non-empty for a folder with children; empty body => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a folder w/ children resolved only by real-uuid (no children) -> RED (the prod face)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The other face (scratch-with-fix): nesting shows but NO verbs (unit unresolved by roomcoll ref). AC: a selected folder shows its verbs (incl add-folder). No-verbs-on-a-resolved-folder => RED.

gateRef.assertion: verbs (incl add-folder) present on a resolved folder; no-verbs => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a folder resolved only by roomcoll-ref (no unit/verbs) -> RED (the scratch face)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Tron in user terms: selecting a folder SHOWS ITS CONTENTS and LETS YOU ADD A FOLDER INSIDE IT — both together, from one selection. This is the user-facing acceptance; both halves work at once, not one-or-the-other.

gateRef.assertion: a selected folder shows contents AND offers a working add-folder; either missing => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed the dual-identity split -> one half missing -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: ROOT LENS (DRY): a room folder has ONE resolution serving BOTH faces (contents + verbs), NOT two APIs each keyed to a different ref that can diverge. The dual identity (real uuid + roomcoll location ref) is UNIFIED into one canonical resolution; the tree does not pick a ref that breaks one detail half. A second/divergent identity resolution => RED. The split identity IS the defect (two places the folder identity lives, they diverge into two broken faces).

gateRef.assertion: a room folder resolves to ONE canonical identity serving /ior + /children; a 2nd divergent resolver => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a 2nd divergent folder-identity resolver -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The exact two-face split must trip RED BOTH ways: (a) a folder resolvable by real uuid (unit/verbs) but NOT by roomcoll ref (children) => RED (prod face); (b) a folder resolvable by roomcoll ref (children) but NOT real uuid (unit/verbs) => RED (scratch face). A suite green on either split is inadmissible.

gateRef.assertion: both seeded split faces (uuid-only, roomcoll-only) observed RED before the fix counts
